title: Wake word asset license manifest
description: Provenance sidecar written next to every downloaded or generated asset (<asset>.license.json).

asset.description: Path of the asset relative to the datasets/ root.

dataset_version.description: Version / release / snapshot date of the source dataset.

commercial_use.description: Whether the license permits commercial use + redistribution.

attribution.description: Attribution string to surface for CC-BY-family licenses.

retrieved.description: ISO date the asset was retrieved / generated (YYYY-MM-DD).

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the asset for reproducibility.
